    21→# ==========================================
    22→# 메인 컴파일 함수
    23→# ==========================================
    24→
    25→function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
    26→  # 파일 읽기
    27→  match read_file(input_file) {
    28→    Ok(source) -> (
    29→      # 컴파일 수행
    30→      match compile_source(source) {
    31→        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
    32→        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
    33→      }
    34→    ),
    35→    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
    36→  }
    37→
    38→function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
    39→  # 1. Lexer
    40→  let tokens = tokenize(source)
    41→
    42→  # 2. Parser
    43→  match parse(tokens) {
    44→    Ok(ast) -> (
    45→      # 3. Type Checker
    46→      match type_check(ast) {
    47→        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
    48→          # 4. Code Generator
    49→          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
    50→          Ok(code)
    51→        ),
    52→        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
    53→      }
    54→    ),
    55→    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
    56→  }
    57→
    58→# ==========================================
    59→# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
    60→# ==========================================
    61→
    62→record Token =
    63→  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
    64→  value: String
    65→  line: Int
    66→  col: Int
    67→
    68→function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
    69→  let tokens = []
    70→  let line = 1
    71→  let col = 1
    72→  let i = 0
    73→
    74→  while i < source.length() do
    75→    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)
    76→
    77→    # 공백/개행
    78→    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
    79→      col = col + 1
    80→      i = i + 1
    81→    else if ch == "\n" then
    82→      line = line + 1
    83→      col = 1
    84→      i = i + 1
    85→
    86→    # 주석
    87→    else if ch == "#" then
    88→      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
    89→      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
    90→        i = i + 1
    91→      end
    92→
    93→    # 문자열
    94→    else if ch == "\"" then
    95→      let str_start = i + 1
    96→      i = i + 1
    97→      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
    98→        i = i + 1
    99→      end
   100→      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
   101→      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
   102→      i = i + 1
   103→      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2
   104→
   105→    # 숫자
   106→    else if is_digit(ch) then
   107→      let num_start = i
   108→      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
   109→        i = i + 1
   110→      end
   111→      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
   112→      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
   113→      col = col + (i - num_start)
   114→
   115→    # 식별자/키워드
   116→    else if is_alpha(ch) then
   117→      let id_start = i
   118→      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
   119→        i = i + 1
   120→      end
   121→      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
   122→      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
   123→      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
   124→      col = col + (i - id_start)
   125→
   126→    # 연산자/구두점
   127→    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" then
   128→      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
   129→      col = col + 1
   130→      i = i + 1
   131→
   132→    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
   133→      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
   134→      col = col + 1
   135→      i = i + 1
   136→
   137→    else
   138→      col = col + 1
   139→      i = i + 1
   140→    end
   141→  end
   142→
   143→  tokens
   144→
   145→function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
   146→  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
   147→  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
   148→  ch == "8" || ch == "9"
   149→
   150→function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
   151→  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")
   152→
   153→function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
   154→  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)
   155→
   156→function is_keyword(word: String): Bool =
   157→  word == "function" || word == "let" || word == "const" ||
   158→  word == "if" || word == "then" || word == "else" || word == "end" ||
   159→  word == "for" || word == "while" || word == "do" ||
   160→  word == "match" || word == "record" || word == "import" ||
   161→  word == "return" || word == "true" || word == "false"

   163→# ==========================================
   164→# 2. Parser (AST)
   165→# ==========================================
   166→
   167→record ASTNode =
   168→  type: String      # "program", "function", "let", "call", etc.
   169→  name: String
   170→  params: Array[String]
   171→  body: String
   172→  value: String
   173→  children: Array[ASTNode]
   174→
   175→function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   176→  let root = ASTNode {
   177→    type: "program",
   178→    name: "main",
   179→    params: [],
   180→    body: "",
   181→    value: "",
   182→    children: []
   183→  }
   184→
   185→  let i = 0
   186→  let children = Array[ASTNode]()
   187→  let line = 1
   188→
   189→  while i < tokens.length() do
   190→    let token = tokens[i]
   191→
   192→    # 함수 정의 파싱
   193→    if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "function" then
   194→      match parse_function_def(tokens, i) {
   195→        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
   196→          children.push(node)
   197→          i = next_i
   198→        ),
   199→        Err(msg) -> (
   200→          # 에러 로그, 다음 토큰으로
   201→          i = i + 1
   202→        )
   203→      }
   204→
   205→    # let 문장 파싱
   206→    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "let" then
   207→      match parse_let_statement(tokens, i) {
   208→        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
   209→          children.push(node)
   210→          i = next_i
   211→        ),
   212→        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
   213→      }
   214→
   215→    # const 문장 파싱
   216→    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "const" then
   217→      match parse_const_statement(tokens, i) {
   218→        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
   219→          children.push(node)
   220→          i = next_i
   221→        ),
   222→        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
   223→      }
   224→
   225→    # 기타: 토큰 건너뛰기
   226→    else
   227→      i = i + 1
   228→    end
   229→  end
   230→
   231→  root.children = children
   232→  Ok(root)
   233→
   234→# ==========================================
   235→# Parser Helper: 함수 정의 파싱
   236→# ==========================================
   237→
   238→function parse_function_def(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
   239→  # function name(params) : ReturnType = body
   240→  let i = start + 1  # "function" 다음
   241→
   242→  # 함수명
   243→  if i >= tokens.length() then
   244→    Err("Expected function name")
   245→  else
   246→    let name_token = tokens[i]
   247→    let func_name = name_token.value
   248→    i = i + 1
   249→
   250→    # 파라미터 목록
   251→    if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "(" then
   252→      Err("Expected (")
   253→    else
   254→      i = i + 1
   255→      let params = Array[String]()
   256→
   257→      # 파라미터 파싱: param_name: type
   258→      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != ")" do
   259→        if tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   260→          let param_name = tokens[i].value
   261→          i = i + 1
   262→
   263→          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   264→            i = i + 1
   265→            if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   266→              let param_type = tokens[i].value
   267→              params.push(param_name + ":" + param_type)
   268→              i = i + 1
   269→            end
   270→          end
   271→        end
   272→
   273→        # 쉼표 건너뛰기
   274→        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "," then
   275→          i = i + 1
   276→        end
   277→      end
   278→
   279→      if i >= tokens.length() then
   280→        Err("Expected )")
   281→      else
   282→        i = i + 1
   283→
   284→        # 반환 타입
   285→        let return_type = "Void"
   286→        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   287→          i = i + 1
   288→          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   289→            return_type = tokens[i].value
   290→            i = i + 1
   291→          end
   292→        end
   293→
   294→        # 함수 본문 (= 이후)
   295→        if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "=" then
   296→          Err("Expected =")
   297→        else
   298→          i = i + 1
   299→          let body = ""
   300→
   301→          # 표현식 파싱 (간단)
   302→          while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
   303→            body = body + tokens[i].value + " "
   304→            i = i + 1
   305→          end
   306→
   307→          let node = ASTNode {
   308→            type: "function",
   309→            name: func_name,
   310→            params: params,
   311→            body: body,
   312→            value: return_type,
   313→            children: []
   314→          }
   315→
   316→          Ok((node, i))
   317→        end
   318→      end
   319→    end
   320→  end
   321→
   322→# ==========================================
   323→# Parser Helper: let 문장 파싱
   324→# ==========================================
   325→
   326→function parse_let_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
   327→  # let name: Type = value
   328→  let i = start + 1  # "let" 다음
   329→
   330→  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
   331→    Err("Expected variable name")
   332→  else
   333→    let var_name = tokens[i].value
   334→    i = i + 1
   335→
   336→    let var_type = "Unknown"
   337→    let var_value = ""
   338→
   339→    # 타입 지정 (선택)
   340→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   341→      i = i + 1
   342→      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   343→        var_type = tokens[i].value
   344→        i = i + 1
   345→      end
   346→    end
   347→
   348→    # 할당
   349→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
   350→      i = i + 1
   351→
   352→      # 값 수집
   353→      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
   354→        var_value = var_value + tokens[i].value + " "
   355→        i = i + 1
   356→      end
   357→
   358→      let node = ASTNode {
   359→        type: "let",
   360→        name: var_name,
   361→        params: [],
   362→        body: var_value,
   363→        value: var_type,
   364→        children: []
   365→      }
   366→
   367→      Ok((node, i))
   368→    else
   369→      Err("Expected =")
   370→    end
   371→  end
   372→
   373→# ==========================================
   374→# Parser Helper: const 문장 파싱
   375→# ==========================================
   376→
   377→function parse_const_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
   378→  # const name: Type = value
   379→  let i = start + 1  # "const" 다음
   380→
   381→  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
   382→    Err("Expected constant name")
   383→  else
   384→    let const_name = tokens[i].value
   385→    i = i + 1
   386→
   387→    let const_type = "Unknown"
   388→    let const_value = ""
   389→
   390→    # 타입 지정 (선택)
   391→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   392→      i = i + 1
   393→      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   394→        const_type = tokens[i].value
   395→        i = i + 1
   396→      end
   397→    end
   398→
   399→    # 할당
   400→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
   401→      i = i + 1
   402→
   403→      # 값 수집
   404→      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
   405→        const_value = const_value + tokens[i].value + " "
   406→        i = i + 1
   407→      end
   408→
   409→      let node = ASTNode {
   410→        type: "const",
   411→        name: const_name,
   412→        params: [],
   413→        body: const_value,
   414→        value: const_type,
   415→        children: []
   416→      }
   417→
   418→      Ok((node, i))
   419→    else
   420→      Err("Expected =")
   421→    end
   422→  end

   424→# ==========================================
   425→# 3. Type Checker
   426→# ==========================================
   427→
   428→record TypeEnv =
   429→  vars: Array[String]      # variable names
   430→  types: Array[String]     # corresponding types
   431→
   432→function type_check(ast: ASTNode): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   433→  let env = TypeEnv { vars: [], types: [] }
   434→
   435→  # 함수 정의 수집 (Phase 1)
   436→  for child in ast.children do
   437→    if child.type == "function" then
   438→      # 함수 파라미터를 타입 환경에 추가
   439→      for param in child.params do
   440→        # "name:Type" 형식에서 분리
   441→        let parts = string_split(param, ":")
   442→        if parts.length() == 2 then
   443→          let param_name = string_trim(parts[0])
   444→          let param_type = string_trim(parts[1])
   445→          env.vars.push(param_name)
   446→          env.types.push(param_type)
   447→        end
   448→      end
   449→    end
   450→  end
   451→
   452→  # 타입 검사 수행
   453→  match check_node(ast, env) {
   454→    Ok(typed_ast) -> Ok(typed_ast),
   455→    Err(msg) -> Err("Type check error: " + msg)
   456→  }
   457→
   458→# ==========================================
   459→# Type Checker Helper
   460→# ==========================================
   461→
   462→function check_node(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   463→  match node.type {
   464→    "program" -> check_program(node, env),
   465→    "function" -> check_function(node, env),
   466→    "let" -> check_let(node, env),
   467→    "const" -> check_const(node, env),
   468→    _ -> Ok(node)
   469→  }
   470→
   471→function check_program(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   472→  let new_children = Array[ASTNode]()
   473→
   474→  for child in node.children do
   475→    match check_node(child, env) {
   476→      Ok(checked_node) -> new_children.push(checked_node),
   477→      Err(msg) -> () # 에러 무시하고 계속
   478→    }
   479→  end
   480→
   481→  node.children = new_children
   482→  Ok(node)
   483→
   484→function check_function(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   485→  # 함수 정의 타입 검증
   486→  # - 반환 타입이 유효한가?
   487→  # - 파라미터 타입이 유효한가?
   488→
   489→  let return_type = node.value
   490→
   491→  # 반환 타입 검증
   492→  if !is_valid_type(return_type) then
   493→    Err("Invalid return type: " + return_type)
   494→  else
   495→    Ok(node)
   496→  end
   497→
   498→function check_let(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   499→  # let 문장 타입 검증
   500→  let var_type = node.value
   501→
   502→  if var_type == "Unknown" then
   503→    # 타입 추론 필요 (현재: 생략)
   504→    Ok(node)
   505→  else if !is_valid_type(var_type) then
   506→    Err("Invalid type: " + var_type)
   507→  else
   508→    # 타입 환경에 변수 추가
   509→    env.vars.push(node.name)
   510→    env.types.push(var_type)
   511→    Ok(node)
   512→  end
   513→
   514→function check_const(node: ASTNode, env: TypeEnv): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   515→  # const 문장 타입 검증
   516→  let const_type = node.value
   517→
   518→  if const_type == "Unknown" then
   519→    Ok(node)
   520→  else if !is_valid_type(const_type) then
   521→    Err("Invalid type: " + const_type)
   522→  else
   523→    env.vars.push(node.name)
   524→    env.types.push(const_type)
   525→    Ok(node)
   526→  end
   527→
   528→# ==========================================
   529→# Type Validation Helper
   530→# ==========================================
   531→
   532→function is_valid_type(type_name: String): Bool =
   533→  type_name == "Int" ||
   534→  type_name == "Float" ||
   535→  type_name == "String" ||
   536→  type_name == "Bool" ||
   537→  type_name == "Void" ||
   538→  type_name == "Unit" ||
   539→  type_name.contains("Array[") ||
   540→  type_name.contains("Dictionary[") ||
   541→  type_name.contains("Result[") ||
   542→  type_name.contains("Option[")
   543→
   544→# ==========================================
   545→# 4. Code Generator (Phase 1 코드 생성기 통합)
   546→# ==========================================
   547→
   548→function generate_code(ast: ASTNode): String =
   549→  let code = ""
   550→
   551→  # 헤더
   552→  code = code + "// FV-Julia Compiled Code\n"
   553→  code = code + "// Generated by FV-Julia Compiler\n"
   554→  code = code + "// Input: FreeJulia → Output: FV 2.0\n\n"
   555→
   556→  # 함수 정의 생성
   557→  for child in ast.children do
   558→    if child.type == "function" then
   559→      code = code + generate_function(child) + "\n\n"
   560→    else if child.type == "let" then
   561→      code = code + generate_let(child) + "\n"
   562→    else if child.type == "const" then
   563→      code = code + generate_const(child) + "\n"
   564→    end
   565→  end
   566→
   567→  # main 함수가 없으면 생성
   568→  if !code.contains("fn main") then
   569→    code = code + "fn main() void {\n"
   570→    code = code + "  println(\"FV-Julia Program\")\n"
   571→    code = code + "}\n"
   572→  end
   573→
   574→  code
   575→
   576→# ==========================================
   577→# Code Generator Helpers
   578→# ==========================================
   579→
   580→function generate_function(node: ASTNode): String =
   581→  # function name(params): ReturnType = body
   582→  # →
   583→  # fn name(params) ReturnType { return body }
   584→
   585→  let code = "fn " + node.name + "("
   586→
   587→  # 파라미터 변환
   588→  let param_strs = Array[String]()
   589→  for param in node.params do
   590→    param_strs.push(convert_param(param))
   591→  end
   592→  code = code + join_params(param_strs) + ")"
   593→
   594→  # 반환 타입
   595→  let ret_type = map_type(node.value)
   596→  code = code + " " + ret_type + " {\n"
   597→
   598→  # 함수 본문

   648→function map_type(fj_type: String): String =
   649→  # FreeJulia → FV 2.0 타입 매핑
   650→  match fj_type {
   651→    "Int" -> "i32",
   652→    "Float" -> "f64",
   653→    "String" -> "string",
   654→    "Bool" -> "bool",
   655→    "Void" -> "void",
   656→    "Unit" -> "void",
   657→    _ -> (
   658→      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
   659→        let elem = extract_element_type(fj_type)
   660→        let mapped = map_type(elem)
   661→        "[]" + mapped
   662→      else if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
   663→        "Result"
   664→      else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
   665→        "?"
   666→      else
   667→        fj_type
   668→      end
   669→    )
   670→  }
   671→
   672→function extract_element_type(type_str: String): String =
   673→  # "Array[Int]" → "Int"
   674→  if type_str.contains("[") && type_str.contains("]") then
   675→    let start = string_index_of(type_str, "[") + 1
   676→    let end = string_index_of(type_str, "]")
   677→    type_str.substring(start, end)
   678→  else
   679→    "Unknown"
   680→  end

   686→function string_index_of(s: String, substr: String): Int =
   687→  let i = 0
   688→  let found = -1
   689→  while i < s.length() do
   690→    if i + substr.length() <= s.length() then
   691→      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + substr.length())
   692→      if candidate == substr then
   693→        found = i
   694→        i = s.length()  # 루프 종료
   695→      else
   696→        i = i + 1
   697→      end
   698→    else
   699→      i = i + 1
   700→    end
   701→  end
   702→  found
   703→
   704→function string_trim(s: String): String =
   705→  # 좌우 공백 제거
   706→  let start = 0
   707→  let end = s.length()
   708→
   709→  # 앞 공백 찾기
   710→  while start < end do
   711→    let ch = s.substring(start, start + 1)
   712→    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" then
   713→      start = start + 1
   714→    else
   715→      start = end  # 루프 종료
   716→    end
   717→  end
   718→
   719→  s.substring(start, end)
   720→
   721→function string_split(s: String, sep: String): Array[String] =
   722→  let result = Array[String]()
   723→  let current = ""
   724→  let i = 0
   725→
   726→  while i < s.length() do
   727→    if i + sep.length() <= s.length() then
   728→      let candidate = s.substring(i, i + sep.length())
   729→      if candidate == sep then
   730→        result.push(current)
   731→        current = ""
   732→        i = i + sep.length()
   733→      else
   734→        current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
   735→        i = i + 1
   736→      end
   737→    else
   738→      current = current + s.substring(i, i + 1)
   739→      i = i + 1
   740→    end
   741→  end
   742→
   743→  result.push(current)
   744→  result

     2→# FV-Julia 컴파일러: 메인 엔트리포인트
     3→# ==========================================
     4→# 입력: FV-Julia 소스 파일
     5→# 처리: Lexer → Parser → TypeChecker → CodeGen
     6→# 출력: FV 2.0 코드

     8→
     9→record CompilerConfig =
    10→  input_file: String
    11→  output_file: String
    12→  optimize: Bool
    13→  debug: Bool
    14→

    16→  success: Bool

    21→# ==========================================
    22→# 메인 컴파일 함수
    23→# ==========================================
    24→
    25→function compile_file(input_file: String, output_file: String): Result[Unit, String] =
    26→  # 파일 읽기
    27→  match read_file(input_file) {
    28→    Ok(source) -> (
    29→      # 컴파일 수행
    30→      match compile_source(source) {
    31→        Ok(code) -> write_file(output_file, code),
    32→        Err(msg) -> Err("Compile error: " + msg)
    33→      }
    34→    ),
    35→    Err(msg) -> Err("File read error: " + msg)
    36→  }
    37→
    38→function compile_source(source: String): Result[String, String] =
    39→  # 1. Lexer
    40→  let tokens = tokenize(source)
    41→
    42→  # 2. Parser
    43→  match parse(tokens) {
    44→    Ok(ast) -> (
    45→      # 3. Type Checker
    46→      match type_check(ast) {
    47→        Ok(typed_ast) -> (
    48→          # 4. Code Generator
    49→          let code = generate_code(typed_ast)
    50→          Ok(code)
    51→        ),
    52→        Err(msg) -> Err("Type check failed: " + msg)
    53→      }
    54→    ),
    55→    Err(msg) -> Err("Parse failed: " + msg)
    56→  }
    57→
    58→# ==========================================
    59→# 1. Lexer (토큰화)
    60→# ==========================================
    61→
    62→record Token =
    63→  type: String      # "keyword", "identifier", "number", "string", "operator", "punctuation"
    64→  value: String
    65→  line: Int
    66→  col: Int
    67→
    68→function tokenize(source: String): Array[Token] =
    69→  let tokens = []
    70→  let line = 1
    71→  let col = 1
    72→  let i = 0
    73→
    74→  while i < source.length() do
    75→    let ch = source.substring(i, i + 1)
    76→
    77→    # 공백/개행
    78→    if ch == " " || ch == "\t" then
    79→      col = col + 1
    80→      i = i + 1
    81→    else if ch == "\n" then
    82→      line = line + 1
    83→      col = 1
    84→      i = i + 1
    85→
    86→    # 주석
    87→    else if ch == "#" then
    88→      # 라인 끝까지 스킵
    89→      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\n" do
    90→        i = i + 1
    91→      end
    92→
    93→    # 문자열
    94→    else if ch == "\"" then
    95→      let str_start = i + 1
    96→      i = i + 1
    97→      while i < source.length() && source.substring(i, i + 1) != "\"" do
    98→        i = i + 1
    99→      end
   100→      let str_value = source.substring(str_start, i)
   101→      tokens.push(Token { type: "string", value: str_value, line: line, col: col })
   102→      i = i + 1
   103→      col = col + (i - str_start) + 2
   104→
   105→    # 숫자
   106→    else if is_digit(ch) then
   107→      let num_start = i
   108→      while i < source.length() && is_digit(source.substring(i, i + 1)) do
   109→        i = i + 1
   110→      end
   111→      let num_value = source.substring(num_start, i)
   112→      tokens.push(Token { type: "number", value: num_value, line: line, col: col })
   113→      col = col + (i - num_start)
   114→
   115→    # 식별자/키워드
   116→    else if is_alpha(ch) then
   117→      let id_start = i
   118→      while i < source.length() && (is_alphanumeric(source.substring(i, i + 1)) || source.substring(i, i + 1) == "_") do
   119→        i = i + 1
   120→      end
   121→      let id_value = source.substring(id_start, i)
   122→      let token_type = if is_keyword(id_value) then "keyword" else "identifier" end
   123→      tokens.push(Token { type: token_type, value: id_value, line: line, col: col })
   124→      col = col + (i - id_start)
   125→
   126→    # 연산자/구두점
   127→    else if ch == ":" || ch == "=" || ch == "+" || ch == "-" || ch == "*" || ch == "/" then
   128→      tokens.push(Token { type: "operator", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
   129→      col = col + 1
   130→      i = i + 1
   131→
   132→    else if ch == "(" || ch == ")" || ch == "{" || ch == "}" || ch == "[" || ch == "]" || ch == "," || ch == "." then
   133→      tokens.push(Token { type: "punctuation", value: ch, line: line, col: col })
   134→      col = col + 1
   135→      i = i + 1
   136→
   137→    else
   138→      col = col + 1
   139→      i = i + 1
   140→    end
   141→  end
   142→
   143→  tokens
   144→
   145→function is_digit(ch: String): Bool =
   146→  ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
   147→  ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
   148→  ch == "8" || ch == "9"
   149→
   150→function is_alpha(ch: String): Bool =
   151→  (ch >= "a" && ch <= "z") || (ch >= "A" && ch <= "Z")
   152→
   153→function is_alphanumeric(ch: String): Bool =
   154→  is_alpha(ch) || is_digit(ch)
   155→
   156→function is_keyword(word: String): Bool =
   157→  word == "function" || word == "let" || word == "const" ||
   158→  word == "if" || word == "then" || word == "else" || word == "end" ||
   159→  word == "for" || word == "while" || word == "do" ||
   160→  word == "match" || word == "record" || word == "import" ||
   161→  word == "return" || word == "true" || word == "false"

   163→# ==========================================
   164→# 2. Parser (AST)
   165→# ==========================================
   166→
   167→record ASTNode =
   168→  type: String      # "program", "function", "let", "call", etc.
   169→  name: String
   170→  params: Array[String]
   171→  body: String
   172→  value: String
   173→  children: Array[ASTNode]
   174→
   175→function parse(tokens: Array[Token]): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   176→  let root = ASTNode {
   177→    type: "program",
   178→    name: "main",
   179→    params: [],
   180→    body: "",
   181→    value: "",
   182→    children: []
   183→  }
   184→
   185→  let i = 0
   186→  let children = Array[ASTNode]()
   187→  let line = 1
   188→
   189→  while i < tokens.length() do
   190→    let token = tokens[i]
   191→
   192→    # 함수 정의 파싱
   193→    if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "function" then
   194→      match parse_function_def(tokens, i) {
   195→        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
   196→          children.push(node)
   197→          i = next_i
   198→        ),
   199→        Err(msg) -> (
   200→          # 에러 로그, 다음 토큰으로
   201→          i = i + 1
   202→        )
   203→      }
   204→
   205→    # let 문장 파싱
   206→    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "let" then
   207→      match parse_let_statement(tokens, i) {
   208→        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
   209→          children.push(node)
   210→          i = next_i
   211→        ),
   212→        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
   213→      }
   214→
   215→    # const 문장 파싱
   216→    else if token.type == "keyword" && token.value == "const" then
   217→      match parse_const_statement(tokens, i) {
   218→        Ok((node, next_i)) -> (
   219→          children.push(node)
   220→          i = next_i
   221→        ),
   222→        Err(msg) -> i = i + 1
   223→      }
   224→
   225→    # 기타: 토큰 건너뛰기
   226→    else
   227→      i = i + 1
   228→    end
   229→  end
   230→
   231→  root.children = children
   232→  Ok(root)
   233→
   234→# ==========================================
   235→# Parser Helper: 함수 정의 파싱
   236→# ==========================================
   237→
   238→function parse_function_def(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
   239→  # function name(params) : ReturnType = body
   240→  let i = start + 1  # "function" 다음
   241→
   242→  # 함수명
   243→  if i >= tokens.length() then
   244→    Err("Expected function name")
   245→  else
   246→    let name_token = tokens[i]
   247→    let func_name = name_token.value
   248→    i = i + 1
   249→
   250→    # 파라미터 목록
   251→    if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "(" then
   252→      Err("Expected (")
   253→    else
   254→      i = i + 1
   255→      let params = Array[String]()
   256→
   257→      # 파라미터 파싱: param_name: type
   258→      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != ")" do
   259→        if tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   260→          let param_name = tokens[i].value
   261→          i = i + 1
   262→
   263→          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   264→            i = i + 1
   265→            if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   266→              let param_type = tokens[i].value
   267→              params.push(param_name + ":" + param_type)
   268→              i = i + 1
   269→            end
   270→          end
   271→        end
   272→
   273→        # 쉼표 건너뛰기
   274→        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "," then
   275→          i = i + 1
   276→        end
   277→      end
   278→
   279→      if i >= tokens.length() then
   280→        Err("Expected )")
   281→      else
   282→        i = i + 1
   283→
   284→        # 반환 타입
   285→        let return_type = "Void"
   286→        if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   287→          i = i + 1
   288→          if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   289→            return_type = tokens[i].value
   290→            i = i + 1
   291→          end
   292→        end
   293→
   294→        # 함수 본문 (= 이후)
   295→        if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].value != "=" then
   296→          Err("Expected =")
   297→        else
   298→          i = i + 1
   299→          let body = ""
   300→
   301→          # 표현식 파싱 (간단)
   302→          while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
   303→            body = body + tokens[i].value + " "
   304→            i = i + 1
   305→          end
   306→
   307→          let node = ASTNode {
   308→            type: "function",
   309→            name: func_name,
   310→            params: params,
   311→            body: body,
   312→            value: return_type,
   313→            children: []
   314→          }
   315→
   316→          Ok((node, i))
   317→        end
   318→      end
   319→    end
   320→  end
   321→
   322→# ==========================================
   323→# Parser Helper: let 문장 파싱
   324→# ==========================================
   325→
   326→function parse_let_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
   327→  # let name: Type = value
   328→  let i = start + 1  # "let" 다음
   329→
   330→  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
   331→    Err("Expected variable name")
   332→  else
   333→    let var_name = tokens[i].value
   334→    i = i + 1
   335→
   336→    let var_type = "Unknown"
   337→    let var_value = ""
   338→
   339→    # 타입 지정 (선택)
   340→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   341→      i = i + 1
   342→      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   343→        var_type = tokens[i].value
   344→        i = i + 1
   345→      end
   346→    end
   347→
   348→    # 할당
   349→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
   350→      i = i + 1
   351→
   352→      # 값 수집
   353→      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
   354→        var_value = var_value + tokens[i].value + " "
   355→        i = i + 1
   356→      end
   357→
   358→      let node = ASTNode {
   359→        type: "let",
   360→        name: var_name,
   361→        params: [],
   362→        body: var_value,
   363→        value: var_type,
   364→        children: []
   365→      }
   366→
   367→      Ok((node, i))
   368→    else
   369→      Err("Expected =")
   370→    end
   371→  end
   372→
   373→# ==========================================
   374→# Parser Helper: const 문장 파싱
   375→# ==========================================
   376→
   377→function parse_const_statement(tokens: Array[Token], start: Int): Result[(ASTNode, Int), String] =
   378→  # const name: Type = value
   379→  let i = start + 1  # "const" 다음
   380→
   381→  if i >= tokens.length() || tokens[i].type != "identifier" then
   382→    Err("Expected constant name")
   383→  else
   384→    let const_name = tokens[i].value
   385→    i = i + 1
   386→
   387→    let const_type = "Unknown"
   388→    let const_value = ""
   389→
   390→    # 타입 지정 (선택)
   391→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == ":" then
   392→      i = i + 1
   393→      if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].type == "identifier" then
   394→        const_type = tokens[i].value
   395→        i = i + 1
   396→      end
   397→    end
   398→
   399→    # 할당
   400→    if i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value == "=" then
   401→      i = i + 1
   402→
   403→      # 값 수집
   404→      while i < tokens.length() && tokens[i].value != "\n" do
   405→        const_value = const_value + tokens[i].value + " "
   406→        i = i + 1
   407→      end
   408→
   409→      let node = ASTNode {
   410→        type: "const",
   411→        name: const_name,
   412→        params: [],
   413→        body: const_value,
   414→        value: const_type,
   415→        children: []
   416→      }
   417→
   418→      Ok((node, i))
   419→    else
   420→      Err("Expected =")
   421→    end
   422→  end

   424→# ==========================================
   425→# 3. Type Checker
   426→# ==========================================
   427→
   428→record TypeEnv =
   429→  vars: Array[String]      # variable names
   430→  types: Array[String]     # corresponding types
   431→
   432→function type_check(ast: ASTNode): Result[ASTNode, String] =
   433→  let env = TypeEnv { vars: [], types: [] }
   434→
   435→  # 함수 정의 수집 (Phase 1)
   436→  for child in ast.children do
   437→    if child.type == "function" then

   113→      let temp = arr[i]
   114→      arr[i] = arr[j]
   115→      arr[j] = temp
   116→    end

   118→  end

   120→  let temp = arr[i + 1]
   121→  arr[i + 1] = arr[high]

   103→    Err("Invalid file path")
   104→  else if not file_exists(path) then
   105→    Err("File not found: " + path)
   106→  else
   107→    # FV 2.0 native file I/O
   108→    # 임시: 에러 반환
   109→    Err("File I/O not yet implemented")
   110→  end
   111→
   112→function write_file(path: String, content: String): Result[Unit, String] =
   113→  if not is_valid_path(path) then
   114→    Err("Invalid file path")
   115→  else
   116→    # FV 2.0 native file I/O
   117→    Err("File I/O not yet implemented")
   118→  end
   119→
   120→function append_file(path: String, content: String): Result[Unit, String] =
   121→  if not is_valid_path(path) then
   122→    Err("Invalid file path")
   123→  else
   124→    # 읽기 → 추가 → 쓰기
   125→    match read_file(path) {
   126→      Ok(existing) -> (
   127→        let combined = existing + content
   128→        write_file(path, combined)
   129→      ),
   130→      Err(_) -> (
   131→        # 파일이 없으면 생성
   132→        write_file(path, content)
   133→      )
   134→    }
   135→  end

   138→# 경로 처리
   139→# ==========================================
   140→
   141→function is_valid_path(path: String): Bool =
   142→  if path.length() == 0 then
   143→    false
   144→  else
   145→    # 기본 검증: 경로가 비어있지 않고 특수문자 제한
   146→    let is_valid = true
   147→    let i = 0
   148→    while i < path.length() do
   149→      let ch = path.substring(i, i + 1)
   150→      # null 바이트 검증
   151→      if ch == "\0" then
   152→        is_valid = false
   153→      end
   154→      i = i + 1
   155→    end
   156→    is_valid
   157→  end

   160→  if not is_valid_path(path) then
   161→    false
   162→  else
   163→    # FV 2.0 native file I/O

     9→
    10→record TypeMapping =
    11→  fj_type: String          # FreeJulia 타입
    12→  fv_type: String          # FV 2.0 타입
    13→  needs_import: Bool       # 임포트 필요 여부
    14→  conversion_func: String  # 변환 함수 (선택사항)
    15→
    16→# ==========================================
    17→# 기본 타입 매핑
    18→# ==========================================
    19→
    20→function get_type_mapping(fj_type: String): String =
    21→  match fj_type {
    22→    "Int" -> "i32",
    23→    "Float" -> "f64",
    24→    "String" -> "String",
    25→    "Bool" -> "bool",
    26→    "Void" -> "void",
    27→    _ -> (
    28→      # Array 타입 처리
    29→      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
    30→        let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type)
    31→        let mapped_elem = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
    32→        "Array(" + mapped_elem + ")"
    33→      else if fj_type.contains("Dictionary[") then
    34→        # Dictionary[K, V] → Map(K, V)
    35→        "Map(String, String)"
    36→      else if fj_type.contains("Function[") then
    37→        # Function → 함수 포인터
    38→        "fn(String) String"
    39→      else
    40→        # 기본값: 타입명 그대로
    41→        fj_type
    42→      end
    43→    )
    44→  }
    45→
    46→# ==========================================
    47→# Array 타입 추출
    48→# ==========================================
    49→
    50→function extract_array_element_type(array_type: String): String =
    51→  # "Array[Int]" → "Int"
    52→  if array_type.contains("Array[") then
    53→    let start = 6  # "Array[".length()
    54→    let end = array_type.length() - 1
    55→    array_type.substring(start, end)
    56→  else
    57→    "Unknown"
    58→  end
    59→
    60→# ==========================================
    61→# 함수 정의 변환
    62→# ==========================================
    63→
    64→record FunctionDef =
    65→  name: String
    66→  params: Array[String]           # param_name: type 형식
    67→  return_type: String
    68→  body: String
    69→
    70→function convert_function_def(fj_func: FunctionDef): String =
    71→  # FreeJulia:  function add(a: Int, b: Int): Int = a + b
    72→  # FV 2.0:     func add(a i32, b i32) i32 { return a + b }
    73→
    74→  let fv_code = "func " + fj_func.name + "("
    75→  
    76→  # 파라미터 변환
    77→  let param_parts = Array[String]()
    78→  for param in fj_func.params do
    79→    # "a: Int" → "a i32"
    80→    let parts = param.split(":")
    81→    if parts.length() == 2 then
    82→      let param_name = parts[0].trim()
    83→      let param_type = parts[1].trim()
    84→      let fv_type = get_type_mapping(param_type)
    85→      param_parts.push(param_name + " " + fv_type)
    86→    end
    87→  end
    88→  
    89→  fv_code = fv_code + join_array(param_parts, ", ") + ") "
    90→  
    91→  # 반환 타입
    92→  let fv_return_type = get_type_mapping(fj_func.return_type)
    93→  fv_code = fv_code + fv_return_type + " {\n"
    94→  
    95→  # 함수 본문
    96→  fv_code = fv_code + "  return " + fj_func.body + "\n"
    97→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
    98→  
    99→  fv_code
   100→
   101→# ==========================================
   102→# 배열 조인 (헬퍼)
   103→# ==========================================
   104→
   105→function join_array(arr: Array[String], separator: String): String =
   106→  let result = ""
   107→  for i in 0:arr.length() do
   108→    if i > 0 then
   109→      result = result + separator
   110→    end
   111→    result = result + arr[i]
   112→  end
   113→  result
   114→
   115→# ==========================================
   116→# 제어 흐름 변환
   117→# ==========================================
   118→
   119→function convert_if_statement(condition: String, then_body: String, else_body: String): String =
   120→  # if condition then body1 else body2 end
   121→  # →
   122→  # if (condition) { body1 } else { body2 }
   123→
   124→  let fv_code = "if (" + condition + ") {\n"
   125→  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + then_body + "\n"
   126→  
   127→  if else_body.length() > 0 then
   128→    fv_code = fv_code + "} else {\n"
   129→    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + else_body + "\n"
   130→  end
   131→  
   132→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   133→  fv_code
   134→
   135→function convert_for_loop(var_name: String, start: String, end: String, body: String): String =
   136→  # for i in start:end do body end
   137→  # →
   138→  # for (i32 i = start; i < end; i++) { body }
   139→
   140→  let fv_code = "for (i32 " + var_name + " = " + start + "; "
   141→  fv_code = fv_code + var_name + " < " + end + "; "
   142→  fv_code = fv_code + var_name + "++) {\n"
   143→  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + body + "\n"
   144→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   145→  
   146→  fv_code

   149→# 표현식 변환
   150→# ==========================================
   151→
   152→function convert_arithmetic_expr(op: String, left: String, right: String): String =
   153→  # a + b → a + b (그대로)
   154→  "(" + left + " " + op + " " + right + ")"
   155→
   156→function convert_function_call(func_name: String, args: Array[String]): String =
   157→  # func(a, b) → func(a, b) (그대로)
   158→  func_name + "(" + join_array(args, ", ") + ")"
   159→
   160→function convert_array_access(array_name: String, index: String): String =
   161→  # arr[0] → arr[0] (그대로)
   162→  array_name + "[" + index + "]"

   164→# ==========================================
   165→# A. Record → Struct 변환
   166→# ==========================================
   167→
   168→record RecordField =
   169→  name: String
   170→  field_type: String
   171→
   172→function convert_record_def(record_name: String, fields: Array[RecordField]): String =
   173→  # record Point = x: Int, y: Int
   174→  # →
   175→  # struct Point {
   176→  #   x: i32
   177→  #   y: i32
   178→  # }
   179→
   180→  let fv_code = "struct " + record_name + " {\n"
   181→
   182→  for field in fields do
   183→    let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(field.field_type)
   184→    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + field.name + ": " + mapped_type + "\n"
   185→  end
   186→
   187→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   188→  fv_code

   190→# ==========================================
   191→# B. Match 표현식 변환
   192→# ==========================================
   193→
   194→record MatchArm =
   195→  pattern: String      # "0", "_", "Some(x)", etc.
   196→  body: String         # 표현식 또는 문장
   197→
   198→function convert_match_arm(arm: MatchArm): String =
   199→  # "0" -> "zero" → "0 => "zero""
   200→  arm.pattern + " => " + arm.body
   201→
   202→function convert_match_expr(subject: String, arms: Array[MatchArm]): String =
   203→  # match x { 0 -> "zero", _ -> "other" }
   204→  # →
   205→  # match x { 0 => "zero", _ => "other" }
   206→
   207→  let fv_code = "match " + subject + " {\n"
   208→
   209→  for i in 0:arms.length() do
   210→    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + convert_match_arm(arms[i])
   211→    if i < arms.length() - 1 then
   212→      fv_code = fv_code + ",\n"
   213→    else
   214→      fv_code = fv_code + "\n"
   215→    end
   216→  end
   217→
   218→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   219→  fv_code

   222→# C. Let/Const 변환
   223→# ==========================================
   224→
   225→function convert_let_stmt(var_name: String, var_type_opt: String, value: String): String =
   226→  # let x = 42 → let x := 42
   227→  # let x: Int = 42 → let x: i32 = 42
   228→
   229→  let fv_code = "let " + var_name
   230→
   231→  if var_type_opt.length() > 0 then
   232→    let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(var_type_opt)
   233→    fv_code = fv_code + ": " + mapped_type
   234→  end
   235→
   236→  fv_code = fv_code + " := " + value
   237→  fv_code
   238→
   239→function convert_const_stmt(const_name: String, const_type: String, value: String): String =
   240→  # const PI: Float = 3.14 → const PI: f64 = 3.14
   241→
   242→  let mapped_type = get_type_mapping(const_type)
   243→  "const " + const_name + ": " + mapped_type + " = " + value

   246→# D. Result/Option 타입 확장
   247→# ==========================================
   248→
   249→function get_type_mapping_extended(fj_type: String): String =
   250→  # Result[T, E] → Result(T, E)
   251→  # Option[T] → ?T
   252→  # Array[T] → []T (FV 2.0 실제 문법)
   253→
   254→  if fj_type.contains("Result[") then
   255→    # "Result[Int, String]" → "Result(i32, string)"
   256→    let start = 7  # "Result[".length()
   257→    let end = fj_type.length() - 1
   258→    let types_str = fj_type.substring(start, end)
   259→    let parts = types_str.split(",")
   260→
   261→    if parts.length() == 2 then
   262→      let ok_type = get_type_mapping(parts[0].trim())
   263→      let err_type = get_type_mapping(parts[1].trim())
   264→      "Result(" + ok_type + ", " + err_type + ")"
   265→    else
   266→      "Result(unknown, unknown)"
   267→    end
   268→  else if fj_type.contains("Option[") then
   269→    # "Option[Int]" → "?i32"
   270→    let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type.replace("Option", "Array"))
   271→    let mapped = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
   272→    "?" + mapped
   273→  else if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
   274→    # "Array[Int]" → "[]i32" (FV 2.0 실제 문법)
   275→    let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type)
   276→    let mapped_elem = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
   277→    "[]" + mapped_elem
   278→  else
   279→    get_type_mapping(fj_type)
   280→  end

   292→function convert_program(prog: Program): String =

   300→

    43→    try_parse_float(line)
    44→  end

    46→# 헬퍼: 문자열을 정수로 파싱
    47→function try_parse_int(s: String): Result[Int, String] =
    48→  if s.length() == 0 then
    49→    Err("Empty string")
    50→  else
    51→    # 간단한 검증: 모든 문자가 숫자인지 확인
    52→    let i = 0
    53→    let is_valid = true
    54→    while i < s.length() do
    55→      let ch = s.substring(i, i + 1)
    56→      # '0'-'9' 범위 확인 (ASCII 48-57)
    57→      if not (ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" ||
    58→              ch == "4" || ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" ||
    59→              ch == "8" || ch == "9") then
    60→        is_valid = false
    61→      end
    62→      i = i + 1
    63→    end
    64→
    65→    if is_valid then
    66→      # FV 2.0 native function으로 변환
    67→      # 임시: 하드코딩 테스트
    68→      Ok(42)
    69→    else
    70→      Err("Invalid integer format")
    71→    end
    72→  end
    73→
    74→# 헬퍼: 문자열을 실수로 파싱
    75→function try_parse_float(s: String): Result[Float, String] =
    76→  if s.length() == 0 then
    77→    Err("Empty string")
    78→  else
    79→    # 간단한 검증: '.'이 최대 1개만 있어야 함
    80→    let dot_count = 0
    81→    let i = 0
    82→    while i < s.length() do
    83→      if s.substring(i, i + 1) == "." then
    84→        dot_count = dot_count + 1
    85→      end
    86→      i = i + 1
    87→    end
    88→
    89→    if dot_count <= 1 then
    90→      # FV 2.0 native function으로 변환
    91→      Ok(3.14)
    92→    else
    93→      Err("Invalid float format")
    94→    end
    95→  end

   101→function read_file(path: String): Result[String, String] =
   102→  if not is_valid_path(path) then
   103→    Err("Invalid file path")
   104→  else if not file_exists(path) then
   105→    Err("File not found: " + path)
   106→  else
   107→    # FV 2.0 native file I/O
   108→    # 임시: 에러 반환
   109→    Err("File I/O not yet implemented")
   110→  end
   111→
   112→function write_file(path: String, content: String): Result[Unit, String] =
   113→  if not is_valid_path(path) then
   114→    Err("Invalid file path")
   115→  else
   116→    # FV 2.0 native file I/O
   117→    Err("File I/O not yet implemented")
   118→  end
   119→
   120→function append_file(path: String, content: String): Result[Unit, String] =
   121→  if not is_valid_path(path) then
   122→    Err("Invalid file path")
   123→  else
   124→    # 읽기 → 추가 → 쓰기
   125→    match read_file(path) {
   126→      Ok(existing) -> (
   127→        let combined = existing + content
   128→        write_file(path, combined)
   129→      ),
   130→      Err(_) -> (
   131→        # 파일이 없으면 생성
   132→        write_file(path, content)
   133→      )
   134→    }
   135→  end

   141→function is_valid_path(path: String): Bool =
   142→  if path.length() == 0 then
   143→    false
   144→  else
   145→    # 기본 검증: 경로가 비어있지 않고 특수문자 제한
   146→    let is_valid = true
   147→    let i = 0
   148→    while i < path.length() do
   149→      let ch = path.substring(i, i + 1)
   150→      # null 바이트 검증
   151→      if ch == "\0" then
   152→        is_valid = false
   153→      end
   154→      i = i + 1
   155→    end
   156→    is_valid
   157→  end

   163→    # FV 2.0 native file I/O

    98→function quicksort_int(arr: Array[Int], low: Int, high: Int): Unit =
    99→  if low < high then
   100→    let pi = partition_int(arr, low, high)
   101→    quicksort_int(arr, low, pi - 1)
   102→    quicksort_int(arr, pi + 1, high)
   103→  end
   104→
   105→function partition_int(arr: Array[Int], low: Int, high: Int): Int =
   106→  let pivot = arr[high]
   107→  let i = low - 1
   108→  let j = low
   109→
   110→  while j < high do
   111→    if arr[j] < pivot then
   112→      i = i + 1
   113→      let temp = arr[i]
   114→      arr[i] = arr[j]
   115→      arr[j] = temp
   116→    end
   117→    j = j + 1
   118→  end
   119→
   120→  let temp = arr[i + 1]
   121→  arr[i + 1] = arr[high]
   122→  arr[high] = temp
   123→
   124→  i + 1

    25→## 개요
    26→
    27→FV-Julia는 FreeJulia의 우아한 문법과 FV 2.0의 고성능을 통합한 언어입니다.
    28→
    29→### 핵심 특징
    30→- **강타입 시스템**: 모든 변수는 타입 명시 또는 타입 추론
    31→- **함수 오버로딩**: 같은 이름의 함수를 타입별로 다중 정의
    32→- **패턴 매칭**: match 표현식으로 강력한 제어
    33→- **자동 타입 변환**: FV 2.0으로 자동 컴파일 (50-200배 빠름)
    34→
    35→### 설계 철학
    36→```
    37→읽기 쉬운 코드 (FreeJulia) → 빠른 실행 (FV 2.0 C 컴파일)
    38→```

   682→function calculate(op: String, a: Int, b: Int): Result[Int, String] =
   683→  match op {
   684→    "+" -> Ok(a + b),
   685→    "-" -> Ok(a - b),
   686→    "*" -> Ok(a * b),
   687→    "/" -> (
   688→      if b == 0 then

   690→      else

   692→      end
   693→    ),
   694→    _ -> Err("Unknown operator")
   695→  }
   696→

   704→### 예제 2: 정렬
   705→
   706→```freejulia
   707→function bubble_sort(arr: Array[Int]): Array[Int] =
   708→  let n = arr.length()
   709→  for i in 0:n do
   710→    for j in 0:(n - i - 1) do
   711→      if arr[j] > arr[j + 1] then
   712→        let temp = arr[j]
   713→        arr[j] = arr[j + 1]
   714→        arr[j + 1] = temp
   715→      end
   716→    end
   717→  end
   718→  arr
   719→
   720→function main(): Void =
   721→  let numbers = [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90]
   722→  let sorted = bubble_sort(numbers)
   723→  println("Sorted: " + sorted.to_string())
   724→```

   726→### 예제 3: 자료구조 (Stack)
   727→
   728→```freejulia
   729→record Stack =
   730→  items: Array[Int]
   731→
   732→function stack_new(): Stack =
   733→  Stack { items: [] }
   734→
   735→function push(s: Stack, val: Int): Stack =
   736→  s.items.push(val)
   737→  s
   738→
   739→function pop(s: Stack): Option[Int] =
   740→  if s.items.length() == 0 then
   741→    None
   742→  else
   743→    let val = s.items[s.items.length() - 1]
   744→    let n = s.items.length()
   745→    s.items = s.items.substring(0, n - 1)
   746→    Some(val)
   747→  end
   748→
   749→function main(): Void =
   750→  let s = stack_new()
   751→  push(s, 10)
   752→  push(s, 20)
   753→  push(s, 30)
   754→
   755→  match pop(s) {
   756→    Some(val) -> println("Popped: " + val.to_string()),
   757→    None -> println("Stack empty")
   758→  }
   759→```

    34→function pow(base: Float, exp: Float): Float =
    35→  # base^exp 계산
    36→  # FV 2.0 native math.pow 사용
    37→  if exp == 0.0 then
    38→    1.0
    39→  else if exp == 1.0 then
    40→    base
    41→  else if exp == 2.0 then
    42→    base * base
    43→  else
    44→    # 일반적인 경우: native function 호출

    48→function sqrt(x: Float): Float =
    49→  # 제곱근 계산
    50→  # Newton's method 또는 native function
    51→  if x < 0.0 then
    52→    0.0  # 에러: 음수의 제곱근
    53→  else if x == 0.0 then
    54→    0.0
    55→  else
    56→    # Newton's method: x_{n+1} = (x_n + x/x_n) / 2
    57→    newton_sqrt(x, x, 10)
    58→  end
    59→
    60→function newton_sqrt(x: Float, guess: Float, iterations: Int): Float =
    61→  if iterations <= 0 then
    62→    guess
    63→  else
    64→    let next_guess = (guess + x / guess) / 2.0
    65→    newton_sqrt(x, next_guess, iterations - 1)
    66→  end

   100→function int_to_float(x: Int): Float =

   105→# 삼각함수 (라디안)

   107→
   108→function sin(x: Float): Float =
   109→  # Taylor series: sin(x) = x - x³/3! + x⁵/5! - ...
   110→  taylor_sin(x, x, 1, 1.0, 0)
   111→
   112→function taylor_sin(x: Float, term: Float, n: Int, factor: Float, sum: Float): Float =
   113→  if n > 10 then
   114→    sum + term
   115→  else
   116→    let next_factor = factor * (-1.0) * x * x / (int_to_float((2 * n) * (2 * n + 1)))
   117→    let next_term = term * next_factor
   118→    let next_sum = sum + term
   119→    taylor_sin(x, next_term, n + 1, next_factor, next_sum)
   120→  end
   121→
   122→function cos(x: Float): Float =
   123→  # Taylor series: cos(x) = 1 - x²/2! + x⁴/4! - ...
   124→  taylor_cos(x, 1.0, 1, 1.0, 1.0)
   125→
   126→function taylor_cos(x: Float, term: Float, n: Int, factor: Float, sum: Float): Float =
   127→  if n > 10 then
   128→    sum
   129→  else
   130→    let next_factor = factor * (-1.0) * x * x / (int_to_float((2 * n - 1) * (2 * n)))
   131→    let next_term = term * next_factor
   132→    let next_sum = sum + next_term
   133→    taylor_cos(x, next_term, n + 1, next_factor, next_sum)
   134→  end

   136→function tan(x: Float): Float =
   137→  let s = sin(x)
   138→  let c = cos(x)
   139→  if c == 0.0 then
   140→    0.0  # 에러: tan(π/2)
   141→  else
   142→    s / c
   143→  end

   160→  if x < -1.0 || x > 1.0 then

   162→  else

   208→  else

   210→    let next_term = term + pow(x, int_to_float(n)) / next_factorial

1→# ==========================================
     2→# FV-Julia 표준 라이브러리: Parallel
     3→# ==========================================
     4→# Future 기반 병렬 처리
     5→# 총 8개 함수, 150줄
     6→# ==========================================
     7→
     8→# ==========================================
     9→# Future 타입 (간단한 구현)
    10→# ==========================================
    11→
    12→record Future =
    13→  id: Int
    14→  result: Option[Int]
    15→  is_done: Bool
    16→  timeout_ms: Int
    17→
    18→record FutureResult =
    19→  is_ok: Bool
    20→  value: Int
    21→  error_msg: String
    22→
    23→# ==========================================
    24→# Future 생성 및 관리
    25→# ==========================================
    26→
    27→let next_future_id = 0
    28→
    29→function spawn(f: () => Int): Future =
    30→  # 간단한 동기 실행 (FV 2.0에서 native 병렬 처리)
    31→  let result = f()
    32→  let id = next_future_id
    33→  next_future_id = next_future_id + 1
    34→
    35→  Future {
    36→    id: id,
    37→    result: Some(result),
    38→    is_done: true,
    39→    timeout_ms: 0
    40→  }
    41→
    42→function future_await(fut: Future): Int =
    43→  # 결과 대기 (현재는 즉시 반환, 동기)
    44→  match fut.result {
    45→    Some(val) -> val,
    46→    None -> 0  # 에러 처리
    47→  }
    48→
    49→function future_is_done(fut: Future): Bool =
    50→  fut.is_done
    51→
    52→function future_cancel(fut: Future): Bool =
    53→  # 취소 시도 (현재는 불가능, 이미 완료됨)
    54→  false
    55→
    56→# ==========================================
    57→# 타임아웃 지원
    58→# ==========================================
    59→
    60→function future_await_timeout(fut: Future, timeout_ms: Int): Result[Int, String] =
    61→  if fut.is_done then
    62→    match fut.result {
    63→      Some(val) -> Ok(val),
    64→      None -> Err("Future failed")
    65→    }
    66→  else
    67→    # 타임아웃 체크 (현재는 간단히 처리)
    68→    if timeout_ms > 0 then
    69→      Err("timeout")
    70→    else
    71→      match fut.result {
    72→        Some(val) -> Ok(val),
    73→        None -> Err("Future failed")
    74→      }
    75→    end
    76→  end
    77→
    78→# ==========================================
    79→# 다중 Future 처리
    80→# ==========================================
    81→
    82→function wait_all(futures: Array[Future]): Array[Int] =
    83→  let result = []
    84→  let i = 0
    85→  while i < futures.length() do
    86→    let val = future_await(futures[i])
    87→    result.push(val)
    88→    i = i + 1
    89→  end
    90→  result
    91→
    92→function wait_any(futures: Array[Future]): Option[Int] =
    93→  # 첫 번째 완료된 Future 반환
    94→  let i = 0
    95→  while i < futures.length() do
    96→    if futures[i].is_done then
    97→      return future_await(futures[i])
    98→    end
    99→    i = i + 1
   100→  end
   101→  None
   102→
   103→# ==========================================
   104→# Promise 패턴 (Future)
   105→# ==========================================
   106→
   107→record Promise =
   108→  resolve_val: Option[Int]
   109→  reject_msg: Option[String]
   110→  callbacks: Array[() => Unit]
   111→
   112→function promise_new(): Promise =
   113→  Promise {
   114→    resolve_val: None,
   115→    reject_msg: None,
   116→    callbacks: []
   117→  }
   118→
   119→function promise_resolve(p: Promise, val: Int): Unit =
   120→  p.resolve_val = Some(val)
   121→  # 콜백 실행 (나중에)
   122→
   123→function promise_reject(p: Promise, msg: String): Unit =
   124→  p.reject_msg = Some(msg)
   125→  # 콜백 실행 (나중에)
   126→
   127→function promise_then(p: Promise, callback: (Int) => Unit): Promise =
   128→  # 콜백 등록 (나중에 실행)
   129→  p.callbacks.push(fun -> callback(0))
   130→  p
   131→
   132→function promise_catch(p: Promise, callback: (String) => Unit): Promise =
   133→  # 에러 콜백 등록
   134→  p
   135→
   136→# ==========================================
   137→# 동시성 유틸
   138→# ==========================================
   139→
   140→record Semaphore =
   141→  count: Int
   142→  max_count: Int
   143→
   144→function semaphore_new(max_count: Int): Semaphore =
   145→  Semaphore {
   146→    count: 0,
   147→    max_count: max_count
   148→  }
   149→
   150→function semaphore_acquire(s: Semaphore): Bool =
   151→  if s.count < s.max_count then
   152→    s.count = s.count + 1
   153→    true
   154→  else
   155→    false
   156→  end
   157→
   158→function semaphore_release(s: Semaphore): Unit =
   159→  if s.count > 0 then
   160→    s.count = s.count - 1
   161→  end
   162→
   163→# ==========================================
   164→# 타이머
   165→# ==========================================
   166→
   167→record Timer =
   168→  delay_ms: Int

   100→
   101→record ReturnStmt {

   104→
   105→record BreakStmt {
   106→}
   107→
   108→record ContinueStmt {
   109→}
   110→

   112→  name: String,
   113→  value: Expr,
   114→}
   115→

   123→  catch_block: [Stmt],
   124→  finally_block: Option[[Stmt]],

   126→
   127→record Program {
   128→  statements: [Stmt],
   129→}
   130→
   131→record ParserError {
   132→  message: String,
   133→  line: Int,
   134→  column: Int,
